facts.fact: TelOne inaugurated a 120-rack, 400 kVA data centre in Bulawayo on 28 April 2022, offering hosting and disaster recovery hosting to banks, telecoms, companies and government customers.
TelOne describes its Bulawayo data centre as a Tier 3 designed facility with redundant power and cooling; stated by the operator, no Uptime Institute certification mentioned.
TelOne opened a data centre at Mazowe, north of Harare, in March 2022.
